study: Known-origin development diagnostic; not accuracy validation

request.prompt: An ordinary handheld phone video in a small kitchen in daylight. An adult wearing a plain green sweater pours coffee from a glass carafe into a white ceramic mug on a wooden counter, sets the carafe down, picks up the mug, and turns toward a window. Natural unpolished home-video appearance, continuous single shot, realistic hands and reflections, subtle handheld movement. Quiet room ambience and liquid pouring, no dialogue, no music, no titles or captions.

estimateLimitation: Published 720p standard rate of USD 0.40 per generated second; actual billing not independently read.

testPlan: Whole generated clip with audio removed and metadata stripped, opaque filename.
Eight-second conventional CGI control from the 2010 Sintel trailer, source seconds 12 to 20, silent and identically encoded.
Same CGI control with source seconds 3 to 5 replaced by generated video seconds 3 to 5, silent and identically encoded.
freeze.derivativeEncoding: 1280x720 padded preserving aspect ratio, 24 fps, H.264 CRF 20, yuv420p, no audio
freeze.interpretation: One generated source and one conventional CGI source. A hit is one diagnostic result. A miss demonstrates a concrete failure on known AI-origin material. No selection among generation outputs and no prompt or threshold tuning after these outcomes.
